**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) at § 14.2 (p0054).**

- **Issue:** § 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for us, with only a revocable, non-transferable licence expiring with the Order Form term. Deliverables (§ 1.4) are work product commissioned and paid for by us, so this fails both the preferred position (Customer ownership via Vendor assignment) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable licence). It also conflicts with § 14.3, which points to the paid-up perpetual licence in § 13.2.
- **Compliant elsewhere:** § 14.1 preserves our ownership of Customer Data and IP with only a limited processing right; § 14.4 bars joint ownership and protects our feedback rights. No edits needed there.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** flips 14.2 to vest Deliverables in Customer with an irrevocable assignment on creation, preserves Vendor's retained Vendor Technology rights under § 14.3, and confirms ownership survives Order Form expiry. Fallback licence language offered in the comment.
